text_en: Wow! One of those Human newcomers.
Come on, if you'd like to know what we can do for you, I'll tell you.
As engineers, Krath and I deal with all kinds of gadgets, so if you have something like a <color=OBJ>Secondary Weapon</color>, we can upgrade it for you.
As long as you bring enough <color=OBJ>Asgarite</color>.
Alright, let's see what we have here.
Wow, man! The soldier bloke again.
